subcommands.add: Add dependencies to a Cargo.toml manifest file
subcommands.bench: Execute all benchmarks of a local package
subcommands.check: Check the current package for errors
subcommands.doc: Build the documentation for the package
subcommands.init: Create a new package in an existing directory
subcommands.publish: Upload a package to the registry
subcommands.remove: Remove dependencies from a Cargo.toml manifest file
subcommands.run: Run a binary or example of the local package
subcommands.test: Execute all unit and integration tests
